assessment: Exact ordered-cell tuple bijection independently verified from captured files. Amend the not-yet-executed export benchmark to compare the same frozen cold-restored representation, without inheriting historical physical qualification.

audit_method.comparison: Counter(tuple(original_ordered_node_sequence)) equals Counter(tuple(restored_ordered_node_sequence)); every tuple is unique in both maps, so the tuple relation induces a bijection of element IDs.
audit_method.coordinate_limit: Original saved coordinate data was independently canonical-hashed. Equality with restored coordinates is backed by the captured native probe receipt and matching canonical hashes; this audit did not perform a new native coordinate observation.

benchmark_scope_amendment.reason: The untouched saved FCStd restores the same unique ordered cell tuples under different public element IDs. A historical live-session ordered ID-to-cell map is therefore not an appropriate identical-representation timing gate for the cold-restored benchmark.
benchmark_scope_amendment.historical_live_session_raw_deck_and_req: Retain unchanged and compare diagnostically. Do not edit or fabricate them to fit restored IDs, and do not make their raw equality the new benchmark's qualification gate.
benchmark_scope_amendment.strict_new_baseline_candidate_contract: Both must open the same original FCStd and pass the exact frozen restored ordered-connectivity hash. Freeze and match the successful new baseline's exact node/group snapshot, selected physical properties, declaration graph, native PORT IDs and request bytes; decks may differ only in the one predeclared written-on timestamp comment. No sorting, relabelling or semantic normalization of candidate output is permitted.
benchmark_scope_amendment.if_restored_hash_or_strict_new_pair_diff: Stop that matched comparison and report the mismatch; do not regenerate or relax the input representation to obtain a speedup claim.
benchmark_scope_amendment.mandatory_fresh_qualification: Full fresh 132-bay analytical physical export/solve/import checks, separate cold verification and 2112 budget refusal remain required with all 3566 original checks and unchanged numerical tolerances, loads, graph, grouping, grounding, ownership guards and declaration budget.

limitations: This is an input-representation and evidence audit, not a target-implementation diagnosis or a timing result.
The ordered-cell bijection does not independently prove native group/result associations, contact/support ownership, export semantics, solver equilibrium or engineering acceptance.
No new export has yet established strict new-baseline output parity; that remains a required future observation.
Reviewer previously authored yzk native capacity C/hooks and a context-lifetime test proposal, but not this restore probe or its execution receipts.
